# 2 Typed models

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-1 (property): Given the models module, When imported, Then it exports the record models.
- AC-2 (behavioral): Given a file with extra columns, When read, Then extra columns are ignored.
- AC-3 (behavioral): Given the models, When type checking runs, Then it passes.

## Slices
1. `2.1` — core models
2. `2.2` — input validation
3. `2.3` — cross-field validation
